reviews.comment: Overall, Prof. Earhart is a very kind woman; her office hours were always very pleasant, and she tried to help however she could. However, the class is heavily exam-based. 90% of your grade is based on exams, which cover about 7 books in total. Because of that, I don't feel as if her lectures provided me with anything the book couldn't.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: ENGL227: Very caring professor and wants you to succeed. Class is based off of 3 exams over readings from class and extra credit if you are in class. The exams are essays, but she starts off easy. Willing to help if you need it! The most time consuming part of this class is studying for the exams. The final isn't cumulative though.

Amazing teacher; very easy class. No quizzes, just 3 exams based directly on the reading with most answers given during class lectures. Attendance not mandatory but sometimes in class attendance is taken as extra credit (doesn't count against you if you're not there, helps you if you are.) I would take her for every class if I could.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's so sweet! ENGL 204 was amazing with her! She is SO insightful and has so many great things to say about everything that is studied in the course. She explains very thoroughly everything that will be on the exams. The class will be so much easier if you do attend and participate, though.

Literally my favorite professor ever, she is so kind and funny. Only 3 exams the entire semester, just get ready to read history books (it was a literature course). Overall my fav ever tho and wish I could have her again.

Dr. Earhart is a great professor. She's understanding and often responds to emails quickly. Beware of the online timed essays if you've never done one. I've always gotten A's on essays until her class because of the time crunch. Essays must be completed in an hour and will auto-submit when time is up. She says quiz answers if you show up to class.

This professor is by far the worst professor I've ever had in my four years of college. She's extremely rude, doesn't care about her students and the worst communicator. Do NOT waste your time taking any of her classes.

Fairly an easy class to get an A in, as there are mini quizzes that focus on the material and no papers to worry about. It is heavy on tests, so try to get a good grade on those and everything should be fine.

As a non-english major, this literature course was not easy, but it was doable and I somewhat enjoyed the class. The professor likes to "demystify the university" for students. The only hard part about this class was the Exams and finding quotes to use on them, so be prepared to recite the themes of the course with citations on exams.

Dr. Earhart is a very sweet professor who does a great job of fostering discussions in the classroom. I never felt pressured or intimidated to contribute and always felt like my contributions were appreciated. For best experience, read the assigned reading and participate in class. She will help you secure that A.

Dr. Earhart is really passionate about what she teaches, and the readings were manageable for a non english major. The group assignments and written assignments boost your grade and both exams are open note + straightforward. She didn't give a lot of feedback on writing itself, but she's approachable if you ask!

Easy as hell, like one of the easiest classes I've ever taken, nothing special. Unfortunately she's really weirdly rude/unpleasant. It wouldn't be a problem, but like it's just so much rudeness and the content of her class can be basically self-taught. It's hard to tell why she is there when you're basically made to teach yourself.
She is a very sweet and passionate professor. Few assignments but she gives a long time for each assignment. Easy class. Answers emails pretty fast.

LOVE HER. If you are not an engl major or like reading/writing take her class. She has a final and gives options. Either a paper or a project you can pick. She cares so much and wants everyone to learn. So So sweet

Earhart is amazing. She's super down to earth and approachable and kind. She's willing to work with you and wants you to do well in her class. I love how she always talks about her sheep. Get ready for fun sideline conversations with her about them and about life in general, slow starts to classes, a comfortable learning environment and fun!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Not great. Tons of reading for tests and quizzes, and a group paper due at the end of the semester that has the worst vague grading criteria I have ever seen given for a project. If you're thinking about taking this course for a language, philosopher, and culture credit, don't. Just take spanish.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Quizzes and assignments are due weekly but aren't bad at all. Honestly I didn't read a single thing all semester and passed everything. The only bad part that brought my grade down was the group project. She didn't make it clear at all what we were going to be graded on and when I asked for clarification by email she was extremely rude to me.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I took Earhart's class online and you're given weekly quizzes over about 8 different readings you read on your own and also had weekly assignments. In general, if you stay on top of your work and deadlines, you'll be okay. But there's a lot to read each week and it's easy to get behind on work. She grades papers really hard and the class is boring.

Overall, most of the class is fairly simple. You'll have a weekly quiz and writing assignment. The final group paper is absolutely ridiculous. There are a million things due during this time, she doesn't use dates but uses "weeks" so "next saturday" is very unclear. NOT an easy online course.

Never read a single thing all semester and made an A in this class. Her TA is always willing to work with you if you need help. Weekly quizzes and assignments but overall don't take up a lot of time. 2 tests that consist mainly of quiz questions. One group essay due at the end of the semester. Super easy class!

The class is very Very easy. I read NONE of the material and I passed with flying colors. However the professor is rude. Every conversation I had in person was awful and she wasnt very condescending. If you dont have a natural inclination for english , she isnt concerned with actually teaching you.

Dr. Earhart is an amazing professor and was very easy to talk to. If you do what is required for the assignments, participate in lecture you will get the grade that you want. Consisted of group project, presentations and papers. 1 final exam that is cumulative. you will get what you put in. This class is a great one to take for an English credit.

Earhart's online class really isn't that difficult. Weekly quizzes are easy and weekly assignments are simple, but graded inconsistently. Group keyword project is kind of a pain, but is graded pretty easily. Readings vary. Range from very historically insightful to dull as dishwater. Overall, not a terrible course, but not that enjoyable either.

This class has weekly assignments, 1 reading quiz that is due Wednesday and some sort of paragraph or assignment due Friday. Those are all really easy. There is also a final group essay that has insanely unclear instructions and is a pretty big waste of time. Prof takes forever to grade as well, took like 6 weeks on the mid term.

I am an English major, w/that being said, if you do not enjoy reading/writing do not take this class! Each week you will have 1 reading quiz and 1 assignment that works toward a final GROUP paper that has unclear directions, but is easy-ish. Only gives a midterm and final that are multiple choice/ FULL essay!! Get ready to write... and fast !
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Earhart is a great prof. Not a ton of reading but still quite a bit. Not many assignments so they each matter but she's pretty cool. She tries to make the class fun

I did not enjoy this class one bit. She is super unclear in her instructions for the weekly assignments and grades on things that were on the instructions. The quizzes are fine but her assignments are annoying because she (or the TAs) grade VERY harsh on unclear, muddy instructions. Even when you email the TAs, you never get a solid answer.

Dr. Earhart is a good professor. The class consists of weekly readings, assignments, and quizzes, all of which are fairly simple if you take your time and actually read them. In addition, there are two tests, both of which are easy. The only grey area is in the group project, as the instructions are not clear, though she is an easy grader.

This online class was very unclear when it came to certain weekly assignments and the major group project. It was so confusing at times, and the TA wasn't that helpful. READ for the class because the midterm and final are both essay based with some multiple questions. Overall, class wasn't that bad if you complete everything.

Terrible professor. VERY unclear directions and zero feedback on assignments. Takes forever to grade anything. Must do quizzes or you fail. Not a hard class because of curriculum but hard because instructions are so unclear that you dont know what you are supposed to be doing. Grade comes down to group project, instructions are extremely unclear.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Took this as an online class. There were weekly quizzes and assignments; a bit tedious but not too hard. You could get by without watching the lectures. She is really caring about assignments if you have a goof or something. The midterm and final were a bit challenging, but overall it was an easy online literature class.

Grades come from weekly assignments, quizzes, a group project, a midterm, and a final. The final is cumulative and you have to write an essay for both tests. The quizzes can be tricky but the answers are usually online. The weekly assignments are fairly easy as well. The class itself isnt too bad though.

Not a bad class. The readings can be long, and the weekly quizzes can be tough, but her lectures help a lot. The weekly assignments aren't too bad, the TA gives helpful feedback. Two exams that are both online, a midterm and a final. The group project is a lot of work and she isn't extremely clear about it, but it isn't super difficult.

I spent the first half of the class living in the Zambian bush for an internship with little access to internet. Regardless, I got every assignment turned in on time. She changed the time of the final the day before and I got locked out. When I went to her office, she called me a bad student. The F has effected scholarship and work opportunities.

This was an online English class i took. There are weekly reading quizzes and assignments; the assignments are rarely hardlong but the quizzes are a bit tough- you MUST read the assigned readings. Sometimes, those are pretty long. Only two tests and a pretty easy group project as the major grades.
Great professor. She's very passionate about what she teaches and she's very approachable. If you read and study you should do fine on her tests.
